adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: Reference log-ratio error0.29974 improves flexible0.43411, but worst-cluster performance is not uniformly superior. Later robust-loss controls are correctly marked postconfirmation diagnostics.

mechanism.rationale: Author-reported depth uncertainty is an output of location processing. Station geometry has a known information role, yet fixed-depth indicators and network conventions can explain much of the fit; no true hypocenter error is measured.

novelty.rationale: Known source analyses and standard mathematical/statistical families are disclosed. This review does not certify a new law or exhaustive novelty.

significance.rationale: Useful catalog-quality modeling with explicit separation of formal uncertainty from physical accuracy.

reproducibility.rationale: Native adapter, frozen equations, coefficients and compact evidence were inspected. Separate computational review performs numerical replay; scientific review is not experimental replication.

impact.rationale: No independent deployed intervention, measured cost benefit or external experimental replication establishes industrial impact.

checks: Case-specific endpoint semantics and prior-art review
Predictor timing and calibration budget review
Named-control comparisons and negative evidence reviewed
No inference of novelty from fit quality
limitations: One July2026 catalog snapshot. Positive uncertainty reports only; mixed network estimation conventions, no universal standard-error confidence interpretation. Counts/geometry are outputs of location processing and causality is not identified.
Agent review is advisory, not independent experimental replication.
